candidates.name: label_vocab_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Maintaining a registry of all canonical label strings seen in training and injecting them as a 'Valid Labels' section at the top of the prompt will reduce label format errors (suffix hallucination, truncation, wrong specificity) and increase val accuracy above 38%.

candidates.name: contrastive_error_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Storing (input_tokens, wrong_prediction, correct_label) contrastive pairs and presenting the top input-similar pairs in a dedicated 'Common Mistakes' section before positive examples will reduce systematic confusion errors and increase val accuracy above 38%.
